description_en: Queries the authorization information about the secure access proxy feature
description_zh: 获取安全访问代理的授权
name: GetProxyAccess

parameters.help_en: The ID that Data Management (DMS) generates after the user is authorized to enable the secure access proxy feature for an instance. The ID is unique in DMS. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295386.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 安全访问授权ID，当安全访问代理授权目标用户后，系统会自动生成一个安全访问授权ID，该ID全局唯一。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295386.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: proxy_access_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

ProxyAccess.description_en: The authorization information about the secure access proxy feature
ProxyAccess.description_zh: 安全访问代理授权信息

AccessId.description_en: The username of the database account that is authorized to enable the secure access proxy feature for an instance
AccessId.description_zh: 安全访问代理授权账号

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the user is authorized to enable the secure access proxy feature for an instance
GmtCreate.description_zh: 安全访问代理权限的授权时间

IndepAccount.description_en: The username of the independent database account

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance for which the secure access proxy feature is enabled

OriginInfo.description_en:
The method that is used to authorize the user to enable the secure access proxy feature for an instance. Valid values:

Authorization by the Alibaba Cloud Account (): The information in the parentheses () indicates the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.
Authorization by submitting the ticket ():The information in the parentheses () indicates the number of the ticket that the user submits to apply for permissions
OriginInfo.description_zh:
开通安全访问代理权限的来源信息，返回值如下：

责任人授权（）：括号中为责任人的UID。
工单授权（）：括号中为用户申请权限的工单号

ProxyAccessId.description_en: The ID that DMS generates after the user is authorized to enable the secure access proxy feature for an instance. The ID is unique in DMS. You can call the [ListProxyAccesses]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295386.html） operation to query the ID
ProxyAccessId.description_zh: 安全访问授权ID，当安全访问代理授权目标用户后，系统会自动生成一个安全访问授权ID，该ID全局唯一。您可以调用[ListProxyAccesses]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295386.html）接口获取该参数

ProxyId.description_en:
The ID of the secure access proxy.

You can call the [ListProxies]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295371.html） operation to query the ID of the secure access proxy
ProxyId.description_zh:
安全访问代理ID。
您可以通过调用[ListProxies]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295371.html）接口获取该参数

UserUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account

RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
